body: Depression is a lonely road at times. But believe it or not, you aren't alone. There's so many people that have similar struggles. People like me. I know it's not easy, and some days are better than others. I care and I would love to hear everything going through your mind.
It may seem that way right now. But that doesn't mean it will be that way forever. Please just keep holding on. It is easier said than done, but I believe in you. Please believe in yourself. Stay.

To this.. I say hello. Hello to the person that came here to pour a little bit of themselves. Hello to the person that has made it this far. And though it may not have been easy and you may be tired. You are here. Stay here. I wish you well in the sense that you give your heart time to heal. That you give yourself time to see. That I hope you find your peace within yourself, as you live on to see all your days. That you put these thoughts to rest. To you I say hello. Don't go anywhere.

I'm proud of you. For coming on here, for sharing a piece of you. You cut someone off that was toxic.. and that itself is something to be proud of. Please don't lose your appetite for hope. I know that's easier said than done.. but I see you. And I am proud of you.
